1.title: 1. Introduction
1.content: Altumia (hereinafter, “Altumia”, “we” or “the Company”), in compliance with Law 1581 of 2012, Decree 1377 of 2013 and other concordant norms on the protection of personal data in Colombia, presents this Privacy Policy describing how we collect, use, store and protect the personal information of our users, clients and visitors.

2.title: 2. Data Controller
2.content:
Business Name: Altumia
Website: altumia.co
Email: service@altumia.co
Address: Bogota, Colombia Barrio los andes

3.title: 3. Definitions
items: Personal Data: Any information linked or that can be associated with one or more specific or determinable natural persons.
Data Subject: Natural person whose personal data is subject to processing.
Processing: Any operation or set of operations on personal data, such as collection, storage, use, circulation or deletion.
Data Controller: Altumia, who decides on the database and the processing of data.
Data Processor: Natural or legal person who performs the processing on behalf of the controller.
Authorization: Prior, express and informed consent of the Data Subject to carry out the processing of personal data.

4.title: 4. Principles for the Processing of Personal Data
4.content: Altumia is committed to applying the following principles in the processing of personal data:
items: Legality: Processing will be carried out in accordance with current regulations.
Purpose: Processing obeys a legitimate purpose, informed to the Data Subject.
Freedom: Processing requires prior, express and informed consent of the Data Subject.
Veracity or Quality: Information must be truthful, complete, accurate and updated.
Transparency: The right of information to the Data Subject is guaranteed.
Access and Restricted Circulation: Processing is subject to the limits of the authorization.
Security: Technical, human and administrative measures will be implemented to protect data.
Confidentiality: All persons involved in the processing are obliged to guarantee confidentiality.

5.title: 5. Personal Data We Collect
5.content: Altumia may collect the following categories of personal data:

5_1.title: 5.1 Identification Data
items: Full name
Identification number (ID, tax ID, passport)
Date of birth
Photograph

5_2.title: 5.2 Contact Data
items: Physical address
Email address
Phone number
Social media

5_3.title: 5.3 Professional and Employment Data
items: Position
Company
Professional information

5_4.title: 5.4 Browsing Data
items: IP address
Browser type
Visited pages
Browsing time
Cookies and similar technologies

5_5.title: 5.5 Financial Data (when applicable)
items: Banking information for payments
Transaction history

6.title: 6. Purposes of Processing
6.content: The personal data collected will be used for the following purposes:

6_1.title: 6.1 Primary Purposes
items: Provision of contracted technological services
Management of the commercial and contractual relationship
Invoicing and payment management
Handling of requests, complaints and claims
Compliance with legal and contractual obligations

6_2.title: 6.2 Secondary Purposes (require specific authorization)
items: Sending commercial, advertising and promotional information
Market research and statistical analysis
Improvement of products and services
Invitations to events, webinars and training
Management of loyalty programs
6_2.note: The Data Subject may object to the processing for secondary purposes at any time.

7.title: 7. Rights of Data Subjects
7.content: In accordance with Law 1581 of 2012, Data Subjects have the following rights:
items: To know, update and rectify their personal data.
To request proof of the granted authorization.
To be informed about the use given to their personal data.
To file complaints with the Superintendence of Industry and Commerce.
To revoke the authorization and request the deletion of data when there is no legal or contractual obligation to keep them.
To access their personal data under processing free of charge.

8_1.title: 8.1 Inquiries
8_1.content:
Data Subjects may inquire about their personal data by means of a request addressed to:
- Email: service@altumia.co
- Physical address: Bogota, Colombia Barrio los andes
Altumia will respond to the inquiry within a maximum of ten (10) business days from the date of receipt.

8_2.title: 8.2 Claims
8_2.content:
Data Subjects may file claims regarding the processing of their data. The claim must contain: Identification of the Subject, description of the facts giving rise to the claim, address and contact details, and documents to be asserted.
Altumia will respond to the claim within a maximum of fifteen (15) business days from the date of receipt. If it is not possible to attend it within said term, the Subject will be informed, expressing the reasons and indicating the date on which it will be attended (maximum 8 additional business days).

9.title: 9. Data Subject Authorization
9.content:
Altumia will obtain the authorization of the Data Subject in an:
- Express manner: Through physical or electronic forms, checkboxes, signatures.
- Implicit manner: When the Subject does not object to the processing after being informed.

Authorization will not be necessary when: it concerns information required by a public authority, data of a public nature, cases of medical urgency, Civil Registry or Commercial Registry data.

10.title: 10. Data Transfer and Transmission
10.content: Altumia may transfer or transmit personal data to technology service providers (hosting, cloud), payment gateways, competent authorities and third parties with a contractual relationship. It will be guaranteed that third parties comply with protection levels similar to those established in this Policy.

11.title: 11. Security Measures
11.content: Altumia implements technical, human and administrative measures to protect personal data, including: Encryption of sensitive data, access control through authentication, firewalls, periodic backups, staff training and confidentiality agreements.

12.title: 12. Data Retention
12.content: Personal data will be kept for the time necessary to fulfill the purposes and as long as legal or contractual obligations exist. Once fulfilled, data will be safely deleted.

13.title: 13. Cookies and Similar Technologies
13.content: Altumia's website uses cookies to improve the experience, analyze traffic and personalize content.
items: Technical cookies: Necessary for the operation of the site.
Analytical cookies: For statistical analysis of site usage.
Personalization cookies: To remember user preferences.

14.title: 14. Data of Minors
14.content: Altumia does not intentionally collect data from minors without prior consent from parents or legal representatives. If it is detected that data from minors has been collected without authorization, its immediate deletion will proceed.

15.title: 15. Modifications to the Privacy Policy
15.content: Altumia reserves the right to modify this Privacy Policy at any time. Modifications will be published on altumia.co with the corresponding update date.

17.content:

Phone: (601) 587 0000

18.title: 18. Validity
18.content: This Privacy Policy is effective as of its date of publication (January 12, 2026) and will remain in effect until modified.

PrivacyPolicy.acceptance: By providing your personal data to Altumia, you declare that you have read, understood and accepted this Privacy Policy and authorize the processing of your data as established therein.
